meta.title: {product} – Operations platform for Shopify stores
meta.description: Orders, shipments, inventory, purchasing, returns, discounts, CRM and the real P/L of Meta and Google campaigns, on one data model. No annual contract, setup done by our team, unlimited users.
meta.og_tagline: One operating platform for Shopify stores

hero.title: Run the whole store on one set of numbers.
hero.subtitle: Orders, shipments, inventory, purchasing, returns, discounts, CRM and the real profit of every Meta and Google campaign. One platform and one data model, instead of four tools that never agree.
hero.screenshot_alt: {product} dashboard for the demo store Harbor Home: sales today, orders, average order value, cancellation rate, a 30-day sales chart and a list of items that need attention

problem.title: Your numbers live in four tools. None of them is right.
problem.lead: A typical Shopify brand runs analytics in one tool, inventory in another, returns in a third and the ads in two dashboards. Each one sees a slice and reports it as the whole.

spread.title: Scattered data
spread.body: The order is in Shopify, the cost in a spreadsheet, the return in the helpdesk, the ad spend in two ad managers. Nobody reconciles them until month end.

placed.title: Profit counted on orders placed
placed.body: Dashboards add up every order placed. Cancellations and returns arrive weeks later and quietly erase the margin you already celebrated.

stock.title: Campaigns that ignore stock
stock.body: The ad manager keeps spending on a product with three units left. The warehouse finds out when the backorders arrive.

stale.title: Decisions made on stale exports
stale.body: By the time the CSVs are merged, the week is over. Reorders, pauses and discounts get decided late, on numbers already out of date.

modules.title: Every module on the same data model
modules.lead: Each module reads the same orders, products, costs and customers. Receive a purchase order and the product cost moves the P/L. Cancel an order and the campaign profit moves with it.

orders.title: Orders
orders.body: A canonical status for every order, mapped from your Shopify tags, payment and fulfilment with rules you control. Timeline with author and diff, internal notes with mentions, customer history and duplicate detection.
orders.alt: Orders list in {product}: each order with its canonical status, payment method and status, channel, assignee and total

shipments.title: Shipments
shipments.body: Tracking, carrier, days in transit, exceptions and shipments stuck beyond your threshold. The visible status is resolved from every source with explicit precedence.
shipments.alt: Shipments page in {product}: counters for in transit, out for delivery, exceptions and stuck shipments, with a list of orders, carriers and tracking numbers

inventory.title: Products and inventory
inventory.body: Variants with dynamic options, stock per location, sales velocity, days of cover and reorder suggestions. Price and status changes are written back to Shopify.
inventory.alt: Inventory page in {product}: units in stock, stock value, critical and low variants, and a list of variants with velocity, days of cover and units to reorder

purchasing.title: Purchasing and reorders
purchasing.body: Suppliers, purchase orders from draft to receipt, incoming stock visible on every product. Receiving updates the product cost, and that cost feeds the P/L.
purchasing.alt: Purchasing page in {product}: purchase orders with supplier, status, expected date, units, total and backorders covered

returns.title: Returns
returns.body: Reasons, windows and workflow states configured per store. Refund, exchange or voucher, optional restock per location, analysis by product and reason.
returns.alt: Returns page in {product}: return requests with order, reason, resolution, amount and workflow status

discounts.title: Discounts
discounts.body: Codes synced from Shopify, single codes and bulk pools of unique codes, with orders, revenue and margin attributed to each code.
discounts.alt: Discounts page in {product}: codes with value, state, uses, orders, discount given, net revenue and margin

crm.title: CRM, segments and RFM
crm.body: Nested AND/OR segment builder on orders, products, value, recency and country, with a live preview. RFM matrix with bands. CSV export and a holdout group built into every segment.
crm.alt: RFM matrix in {product}: customers by recency and frequency with revenue per cell, and bands such as champions and loyal

analytics.title: Analytics and P/L
analytics.body: KPIs with period comparison and a P/L net of tax: cost of goods, shipping, payment fees, returns and ad spend. Every number opens the orders behind it.
analytics.alt: Profit and loss in {product}: gross sales, refunds, tax, net revenue, cost of goods, gross margin, shipping, payment fees, advertising and operating profit

campaigns.title: Campaigns linked to stock
campaigns.body: Meta and Google campaigns linked to products. Profit counts only orders that were not cancelled or returned. Recommendations look at the stock of the linked products before telling you to spend more.
campaigns.alt: Campaigns page in {product}: spend, orders, net revenue, margin, profit, ROAS, ROI, CPA and a health indicator for each Meta and Google campaign

how.title: How it works
how.lead: Three steps. The second one is ours.

connect.title: Connect Shopify, Meta and Google
connect.body: OAuth or a custom app token for Shopify, API access for Meta and Google Ads. Webhooks are verified, queued and retried; the historical sync runs in the background and resumes if interrupted.

configure.title: We configure rules, costs and history
configure.body: Our team sets up status rules, tax rates, payment fees, product costs, the history import and your users with their roles. You start on a configured platform, not an empty one.

operate.title: Operate from one platform
operate.body: Operations, customer care and marketing work in the same place with their own permissions. Changes that matter are written back to Shopify.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.lead: Four plans by order volume. Unlimited users on every plan. No annual contract required.
pricing.overage: Above the included orders: {price} per {n} extra orders, billed at month end.

features.pnl: P/L per order and per period

addons.title: Add-ons and tailored integrations
addons.lead: Activated per account by our team. The core works for any payment method; what is specific to your operation lives in an add-on.

cod.title: Cash on delivery
cod.body: Confirmation queue with call outcomes, operator assignment, a delivery score explained factor by factor and risk flags on recipients.

custom_integration.title: Tailored integrations
custom_integration.body: A 3PL warehouse, a local messaging provider, a carrier: built behind the same interfaces and switched on for your account only.

ai_studio.title: AI Studio
ai_studio.body: Ask questions on your own data and automate recurring analyses. Billed on usage.

custom_development.title: Custom development
custom_development.body: A module your operation needs and nobody else has. Scoped and quoted.

payments.a: All of them. Card, wallets, PayPal, bank transfer, buy now pay later and cash on delivery are equivalent in the data model. Cash on delivery operations (confirmation calls, delivery score) are an add-on you activate only if you need it.

contracts.a: No. Plans are monthly and you can cancel at the end of any month. The annual option exists only to give you two months free; it is never required.

setup.a: Connecting Shopify, Meta and Google, importing your order history, configuring status rules, tax rates, payment fees, product costs and your users with their roles. You start on a configured platform, not an empty one.

security.q: How are my data kept separate from other customers?
security.a: Every table carries the account identifier and the database enforces row-level isolation on every query: an account can never read or write another account's rows, and automated tests prove it on every table. Integration credentials are encrypted at rest. Access by our support team is logged and visible to you.

overage.q: What happens if I exceed the included orders?
overage.a: Nothing stops. Extra orders are billed at {price} per {n} orders at month end. If it happens two months in a row we suggest the next plan, which usually costs less.

languages.a: The product is available in English, Italian and Spanish, chosen per user. Dates, numbers and currencies follow the settings of your store and of each user.

cta.title: See {product} on your numbers.
cta.body: A 30-minute demo on the demo store, or on an export of your own orders if you prefer.
